description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Tactical Brethren enhancement LAURELS OF VIGILANCE (WP-M2b): (once per battle round, per army) FIRE OVERWATCH / HEROIC INTERVENTION on a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit within 12" of the bearer is -1CP. Fixture sm11e_m2b_marines_active (the Lieutenant carries it, ~5" from the Intercessor Squad — BATTLELINE). The HUD Skip Overwatch toggle is turned OFF with a real click. Setup privileges: it is the Ork player's Movement phase (active player 2), the Space Marine player has 0 CP (P2 0 CP too). At the end of the Ork Movement phase the FIRE OVERWATCH window opens for the Space Marine player although it has 0 CP: only the discounted Intercessor Squad is offered; a REAL click on Use + the Meganobz as target: P1 still has 0 CP afterwards and the Game Log names Laurels of Vigilance.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description; the Meganobz moved 4" closer — still out of engagement)
a window not under test (if any) is declined
REAL click: turn the HUD's Skip Overwatch toggle OFF (it is ON by default)
the Ork player ends the Movement phase (movement panel's End Movement)
only the discounted Intercessor Squad can use FIRE OVERWATCH at 0CP
a window not under test (if any) is declined
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
